tools.name: fl_ping
tools.title: Ping FL Studio
tools.description:
Check that FL Studio is running and the controller script is loaded.

Returns the controller's reported FL Studio version, the age of the
last heartbeat in seconds, and the MIDI port names in use. Call this
first when something seems wrong.

tools.name: fl_get_tempo
tools.title: Get tempo (BPM)
tools.description: Return the current FL Studio project tempo in beats per minute.

tools.name: fl_get_play_state
tools.title: Get play state
tools.description: Return whether FL is currently playing and / or recording.

tools.name: fl_get_song_position
tools.title: Get song position (beats)
tools.description: Return the current playhead position in beats from the song start.

tools.name: fl_get_project_state
tools.title: Get project state
tools.description: Tempo, transport state, pattern/channel/mixer counts.

tools.name: fl_get_mixer_state
tools.title: Get mixer state
tools.description:
All mixer tracks (index, name, volume, pan, mute, solo). Names in
this overview are truncated; use a single-track read for the full name.

tools.name: fl_get_channel_state
tools.title: Get channel state
tools.description: Currently visible Channel Rack group (index, name, volume, pan, mute, solo). Switch GUI filter to All before relying on global indices.

tools.name: fl_take_snapshot
tools.title: Take snapshot
tools.description: Read current state for a scope (for your own before/after diffing).

tools.name: fl_plugin_list
tools.title: List plugins on a mixer track
tools.description:
List the filled effect slots (0-9) on a mixer track, with plugin names.

We cannot load NEW plugins (FL API limit) -- this only reports plugins
already present in the project.

annotations.title: List plugins on a mixer track

tools.name: fl_plugin_get_params
tools.title: Get plugin parameters
tools.description:
Every named parameter of the plugin in this slot: index, name,
normalised value (0..1) and FL's display string (e.g. '3.6dB',
'500Hz'). Returns {"total", "params":[{"i","name","v","s"}, ...]}.

slot.description: Effect slot 0-9; -1 addresses generator on channel index track.

tools.name: fl_plugin_state
tools.title: Read bounded live plugin state
tools.description: Read actual plugin values/display strings. slot=-1 addresses current Channel Rack FILTER index, not necessarily native FLP global channel: select All through GUI and pass expected_channel for pre/post name guards. Effects use Mixer track/slot. complete=true reads at most4096 parameters within60s on stopped transport, with real single-parameter fallback if a page fails; it is non-atomic. Missing/mismatched values fail, never filled. Not preset identity or full proprietary state.

tools.name: fl_get_track_level
tools.title: Get track level (dB)
tools.description:
Measure a mixer track's level by sampling meter peaks over a short
window. Requires PLAYBACK -- returns playing=False (avg/peak null) when
stopped/silent. {track, playing, avg_db, peak_db}.

tools.name: fl_get_routing
tools.title: Get mixer track routing
tools.description:
Which destination tracks this mixer track sends to:
{track, name, routes_to:[{dst, dst_name, level?}]}.

tools.name: fl_get_routing_all
tools.title: Get full routing matrix
tools.description:
Routing for every mixer track (paginated under the hood, returned
whole): {total, routing:[{i, name, routes_to:[...]}]}.

tools.name: fl_get_channel_routing
tools.title: Get channel->mixer routing
tools.description:
Which mixer track each channel-rack channel is linked to:
{total, channels:[{channel, name, target_mixer_track, target_name}]}.

tools.name: fl_detect_cleanup_candidates
tools.title: Detect cleanup candidates (read-only)
tools.description:
Flag (do NOT touch) empty channels + unused mixer tracks, each with a
reason. Judgement is computed server-side from cheap controller reads.
Channel emptiness is a name heuristic; unused-track detection is reliable.

tools.name: fl_analyze_audio
tools.title: Analyze audio (tempo/key)
tools.description:
Estimate tempo + key (+ duration, beats, onsets) of an audio file.
Pure offline analysis -- does NOT touch FL. Key is ESTIMATED.

path.description: Path to a WAV/MP3 file (MP3 needs ffmpeg on PATH).

tools.name: fl_extract_melody
tools.title: Extract melody from audio (pyin/CREPE)
tools.description:
Transcribe a monophonic melody to quantized notes; engine-selectable
(CREPE = accurate/heavy, pyin = light). Returns ALL notes with confidence
+ a `kept` flag; bridge_notes holds only the confident notes, ready for
fl_write_piano_roll_notes. Does NOT write to FL -- review first.

path.description: Path to a MONOPHONIC source (solo vocal/lead/stem).

bpm.description: Override BPM for bar quantization; auto-detected if omitted.

engine.description: Pitch engine: 'crepe' (accurate, needs [audio-accurate] extra), 'pyin' (light), or 'auto' (default: crepe if installed). Overrides $FLSTUDIO_MCP_PITCH_ENGINE.

min_conf.description: Confidence gate 0..1 deciding which notes enter bridge_notes (default 0.8 crepe / 0.0 pyin). ALL notes are still returned with voiced_prob + a kept flag.

tools.name: fl_list_chains
tools.title: List genre chains
tools.description:
List the built-in genre processing-chain recipes (vocal, drum_bus,
bass, master) and their ordered steps.

tools.name: fl_list_installed_plugins
tools.title: List installed plugins (FL DB on disk)
tools.description:
Read FL's installed-plugin DATABASE from disk (the .fst shortcuts FL
writes for every scanned plugin) -> a de-duped, categorized list of what
you OWN. Bypasses the FL API (which only sees LOADED plugins). FL still
can't LOAD these -- it's for library-aware suggestions. effects_by_role is
a rough keyword grouping (Claude should apply its own plugin knowledge).
Read-only (directory listing only).

annotations.title: List installed plugins (FL DB on disk)

tools.name: fl_setup_chain
tools.title: Set up a genre chain (plan)
tools.description:
Plan a genre-appropriate processing chain over a track's EXISTING
plugins. READ-ONLY plan: returns the ordered intent calls (each with the
matched plugin + slot) and which steps are MISSING because the needed
plugin isn't loaded (FL can't load plugins -- add those manually). After
the user approves, apply each step by calling its 'apply' tool+args
(fl_apply_eq_intent / fl_apply_compression_intent / fl_apply_reverb_intent
-- each logged + rollback-able). e.g. vocal: HP -> comp -> presence ->
air -> reverb.

tools.name: fl_list_presets
tools.title: List presets (from disk)
tools.description:
Read preset NAMES from disk: FL Presets\ (per-plugin 'Plugin presets',
plus Channel/Mixer presets) + Serum 2 Presets (.serumpreset). With NO
filter -> a SUMMARY (which plugins have presets + counts). With
plugin_filter -> that plugin's full preset list. Read-only. FL can't LOAD
presets via the API -- this is for suggestions (you load the named preset,
then Claude can tweak it).

plugin_filter.description: Plugin to narrow to (e.g. 'Serum', 'Fruity Parametric EQ 2'); omit for a summary.

tools.name: fl_suggest_preset
tools.title: Suggest a preset by description
tools.description:
Suggest presets from YOUR library matching a description, for a given
plugin. Reads the plugin's preset NAMES from disk + ranks by name match.
Name-only (can't hear the sound) -- apply your own knowledge of preset
naming. FL can't LOAD presets via the API: recommend which to load in the
plugin manually; AFTER the user loads it you can tweak its params via
fl_plugin_set_param / fl_apply_*_intent.

description.description: The sound you want, e.g. 'vintage bass', 'bright pluck'.

plugin.description: Plugin whose presets to search, e.g. 'Serum'.

tools.name: fl_diagnose_mix
tools.title: Diagnose the mix (Mix Doctor)
tools.description:
Scan the WHOLE mix and report problems + proposed fixes. READ-ONLY.

Transparent threshold rules (clipping, headroom, level imbalance, missing
high-pass, ungrouped tracks, EQ clashes) on a thin paginated snapshot;
returns findings (severity + exact evidence) + concrete proposals.

IMPORTANT: this samples peaks over only ~1.2s -- one MOMENT of the song,
so it can MISS clipping in a drop/chorus that isn't playing right now. For
full-song-accurate levels use WATCH mode: fl_mix_watch_start -> play the
whole song -> fl_mix_watch_stop. If stopped, level rules are skipped
(needs_playback). Applies nothing.

tools.name: fl_mix_watch_start
tools.title: Start full-song peak watch (Mix Doctor)
tools.description:
Begin a peak-HOLD watch: continuously sample every mixer track's peak,
keeping a RUNNING MAX per track, until fl_mix_watch_stop. Tell the user to
PLAY the whole song (or at least the loudest section / the drop) while this
runs -- then stop for full-song-accurate level diagnosis. Read-only.

interval_ms.description: Poll interval per round in ms (default 150).

tools.name: fl_mix_watch_status
tools.title: Peak watch status (Mix Doctor)
tools.description: Is a peak watch running, and for how long / how many polls so far?

tools.name: fl_mix_watch_stop
tools.title: Stop peak watch + diagnose (Mix Doctor)
tools.description:
Stop the peak watch and diagnose on the FULL-SONG running-max peaks
captured across the whole watch (accurate clipping/headroom/imbalance vs
the ~1.2s snapshot). Read-only -- proposes fixes, applies nothing.

tools.name: fl_gain_stage
tools.title: Gain staging assistant (Mix Doctor)
tools.description:
Propose per-track fader trims so each track's peak sits in a healthy
band (~-12..-6 dBFS, aim -9) and the Master keeps -3..-6 dB headroom.
READ-ONLY proposals -- apply approved ones via fl_apply_mix_fix (rollback).

Uses FULL-SONG peaks from a recent watch (fl_mix_watch_start -> play ->
fl_mix_watch_stop) when available; else a ~1.2s snapshot (prefer watch).
FL's fader is POST-chain, so this sets a track's OUTPUT level, not a true
pre-plugin input trim.

tools.name: fl_reference_match
tools.title: Compare actual reference and mix files
tools.description:
Compare equal-duration DECODED audio, RMS matched in memory.
An actual rendered mix file is required. Never estimates spectrum from
track names or peaks. No audio is modified and no listening is claimed.
RMS matching is not perceptual loudness/LUFS matching.

annotations.title: Compare actual reference and mix files

tools.name: fl_system_health
tools.description: Check dependency versions and existing local daemon using bounded reads; never starts or reconfigures FL.

tools.name: fl_project_checkpoint
tools.description: Copy an existing saved FLP to a NEW path and verify SHA256. Does not save unsaved FL state or open a project. Existing destinations are never overwritten; same job inputs reuse verified evidence.

tools.name: fl_verify_render
tools.description: Decode actual audio; reject missing, corrupt, nonfinite, empty, silent or unexpected-duration output. Report actual format/sample peak/RMS/clipping. This does not render or listen.

tools.name: fl_compare_renders
tools.description: Compare decoded audio including all samples; classify exact PCM, numeric difference or format/duration change. Never infer aesthetic quality from numbers.

tools.name: fl_workflow_status
tools.description: Read persistent step evidence. Interrupted/failed mutations require inspection and a new version; no blind retry or automatic replay.

tools.name: fl_inspect_native_project
tools.description: Read a saved FL26.1.5 FLP: full note records, instrument state hashes, sample references, Playlist extents and automation. Never opens, rewrites, or claims to inspect unsaved state. Unknown event layouts fail explicitly.

tools.name: fl_ui_observe
tools.description: Observe actual FL windows, UIA controls and screenshots. No bridge or project writes. Returns expiring tokens for UI input.

tools.name: fl_ui_locate_piano
tools.description: Automatically measure visible Piano Roll using native anchors, screenshot grid lines and Windows OCR octave/time labels. No GUI input. Unknown grid/language/scale fails with diagnostic images; success requires independent saved-note verification after editing.

tools.name: fl_ui_act
tools.description: Real GUI input on an unchanged observed FL window and owned project. UIA invoke/set_value/select require an exact observed selector; raw click/right_click/drag use normalized window fractions. piano_draw/move/resize/delete use piano_note/target and automatically measured grid when piano_grid is omitted. Bar snap must be selected/verified in GUI before piano_snap_bar=true. text_click selects unique actual OCR text, optionally handle=active_popup. activate raises a visible editor/plugin. sytrus_presets_menu/master_menu require tested stock profile. automation_move_value takes automation_edit={channel,point_index,value}: existing visible non-flat purple curve only, no timing edit. Draw inherits FL length/velocity. Single-use journal; input_sent and screenshot change are not musical success. Save NEW checkpoint and verify native/live/audio results. Never writes FLP/MIDI/bridge parameters.

tools.name: fl_desktop_state
tools.description: Read real FL process/window title, enabled state, modal dialogs and geometry. Does not close windows. Dirty-state is unknown.

tools.name: fl_gui_save_as
tools.description: Save current actual FL project to a NEW FLP via UIA; reject title mismatch/overwrite, parse actual saved bytes and establish owned GUI session. Captures unsaved changes without overwriting original.

tools.name: fl_gui_open_project
tools.description: Preserve current FL state by Save As to NEW path, open existing FLP via UIA, save to another NEW path and compare native semantics. Missing plugin/modal dialogs are NOT dismissed automatically.

tools.name: fl_gui_render_wav
tools.description: Render actual FL audio to a NEW WAV: UIA file chooser, verified FL26 render form, clear time selection, Cut remainder, bounded completion and full PCM integrity. Unknown window layouts fail; output format is reported from actual audio.

tools.name: fl_playlist_calibrate
tools.description: With no arguments, measure native anchors plus OCR ruler/Track labels. Or supply all four explicit screenshot measurements. Requires owned project, bar1/track1, uniform tracks and 4/4. Calibration alone is not musical verification.

tools.name: fl_playlist_edit
tools.description: Edit an existing Pattern clip through real calibrated FL GUI. Makes a NEW native pre-checkpoint, refuses stale/overlapped/out-of-view state, saves NEW result and verifies clip/source/track/offset plus all other musical state. Failed artifacts retained; no FLP byte mutation.
